text: This report requests City Council's authority to amend Toronto Water's Approved 2017 Capital Budget and 2018-2026 Capital Plan by adjusting project costs and cash flows contained within the Budget and Plan, respectively, to align with year-end expenditures and project progress. The adjustments will have a zero dollar impact on the 2017 Capital Budget and 2018-2026 Capital Budget and Plan and will align the budget and plan with Toronto Water's capital project delivery schedule and program requirements.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the reallocation of funds within the Approved 2017 Capital Budget and 2018-2026 Capital Plan for Toronto Water in the amount of $27.298 million, for acceleration and deferral of projects, as presented in Schedule A (Parts A and B) to the report (March 8, 2018) from the Interim Chief Financial Officer, with a zero Budget impact. 2. City Council authorize the reallocation of funds in the Approved 2017 Capital Budget for Toronto Water in the amount of $2.856 million from projects that have been completed or awarded under budget to those requiring additional funding in the same amount as presented in Schedule A (Part C) to the report (March 8, 2018) from the Interim Chief Financial Officer, with a zero Budget impact.
